name: Nathan LaFavor
description: Nathan LaFavor was one of the CFC Potsdam youth group leaders when JD started attending in 2013; Daniel Paladin later took over the role. He is the owner of LaFaver's Painting LLC of Madrid, NY, a residential painting business serving the Potsdam/Canton area.
public_footprint:
Nathan LaFaver of Madrid, NY is owner of LaFaver's Painting LLC in Madrid; he runs operations, hiring, and day-to-day projects, offering interior/exterior painting, power washing, sheetrocking, wallpaper removal, and cabinet restoration, with work in Potsdam and Canton. LaFaver's Painting, LLC is listed at 3712 County Route 14, Madrid, NY 13660.
